description: A source file implementing the ArcBufferWriter class, which is a specialized buffer writer using pooled pages to efficiently create ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers namespace. It includes buffer management, page pooling, and slice handling with reference counting and versioning for safety.

classes.name: ArcBuffer
classes.description: A slice representing a segment of an ArcBufferWriter's data, providing methods for copying, slicing, and managing lifetime through pinning and unpinning.

classes.name: ArcBufferPage
classes.description: Represents a page of data in the buffer, managing memory, reference counting, versioning, and linking to other pages.

classes.name: ArcBufferPagePool
classes.description: A singleton pool managing free pages of data for allocation and recycling to minimize memory overhead.

methods.name: ArcBufferWriter()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer writer with an initial page.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Property returning the number of unconsumed bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: ReplenishBuffers(List<ArraySegment<byte>> buffers)
methods.description: Fills the provided buffer list with available buffer segments, allocating new pages as necessary.

methods.name: AdvanceWriter(int count)
methods.description: Advances the write position in the buffer by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the writer, releasing all pages and resetting counters.

methods.name: Dispose()
methods.description: Disposes the buffer writer, unpinning pages and freeing resources.

methods.name: GetMemory(int sizeHint)
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing, expanding pages if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan(int sizeHint)
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, expanding pages if necessary.

methods.name: Peek(scoped in Span<byte> destination)
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> of the unread data, attempting to fit into the destination span.

methods.name: Peek(Span<byte> output)
methods.description: Copies unread data into output span without advancing read position.

methods.name: Write(ReadOnlySequence<byte> input)
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySequence<byte> into the buffer.

methods.name: Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte> value)
methods.description: Writes a span of bytes into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment(in ReadOnlySpan<byte> source, Span<byte> destination)
methods.description: Helper to write multi-segment data into the buffer.

methods.name: UnpinAll()
methods.description: Unpins all pages: allows pages to be returned to the pool.

methods.name: PeekSlice(int count)
methods.description: Returns an ArcBuffer representing a slice of data without consuming it.

methods.name: ConsumeSlice(int count)
methods.description: Returns an ArcBuffer slice and advances the read cursor.

methods.name: AdvanceReader(int count)
methods.description: Moves the read cursor forward by specified number of bytes, unpinning pages if fully consumed.

methods.name: AllocatePage(int sizeHint)
methods.description: Allocates a new page from the pool.

methods.name: AdvanceWritePage(int sizeHint)
methods.description: Advances the write page, allocating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: ThrowIfDisposed()
methods.description: Throws ObjectDisposedException if the writer has been disposed.
